parameters.name: ClusterIds
parameters.description: The name of the registered service.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The type of the registered service. Valid values:

*   `ServiceEntry`: indicates that the service is registered by creating a service entry.
*   `Kubernetes`: indicates that the service is registered on a Kubernetes cluster on the data plane.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The IDs of clusters in the ASM instance. Separate multiple cluster IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description: The endpoints of the registered service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh get-registered-service-endpoints --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --namespace default --cluster-ids c8b054ee8c3914d079b5ce97333280000,c58faedb8a78640d3aeb0372e4c020000 --name reviews --service-type Kubernetes --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh GetRegisteredServiceEndpoints --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --ServiceType Kubernetes --ClusterIds 'c8b054ee8c3914d079b5ce97333280000,c58faedb8a78640d3aeb0372e4c020000' --Namespace default --Name reviews
